PURCHASE ORDER
PO Number: RIDGE-PO-2024-1187
Issued: June 20, 2024
Buyer: Ridgeline Manufacturing Corp., 4400 Industrial Way, Cleveland, Ohio.
Seller: Aperture Sensors LLC, 91 Hollis Street, Cambridge, Massachusetts.

Line 1: 250 units Aperture VS-4200 vibration sensors, at $412.00 per unit.
Line 2: 250 units Aperture VS-4200 mounting brackets, at $38.00 per unit.
Line 3: On-site calibration service, one flat fee of $8,400.

Total: $120,900.00, plus applicable taxes.

Ship to: Cleveland Facility, Dock B, 4400 Industrial Way.
Requested delivery: July 22, 2024.
Payment terms: Net 30 from delivery and acceptance.

BUYER'S TERMS AND CONDITIONS (BINDING):
1. Time is of the essence. Delivery later than the Requested Delivery date is a
   material breach and entitles Buyer to reject the entire shipment.
2. All goods must conform strictly to the specifications identified above and
   in Buyer's specification package RID-SPEC-4200 (attached to this PO).
3. Buyer's inspection period is fifteen (15) business days from delivery.
4. Any additional or different terms in Seller's acknowledgment or invoice are
   objected to and are not part of the contract.
5. Governing law: Ohio. Forum: state or federal courts located in Cuyahoga
   County, Ohio.

Authorized by A. Ndlovu, Director of Operations, June 20, 2024.
